notes.title: Mapper Update
notes.content:
Mapper has been promoted from a second player character to an alternate single player character, available via a block, a bit like a power up. This also opens the door for future characters in updates or mods.

A second player is still available but will simply receive a "P2" badge now.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 10th, 2024
notes.content: More control adjustments based on feedback and minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 8th, 2024
notes.content: Controls have been adjusted to be less floaty and less slippery.
